scope: Explicit requested-case convergence status. Completed fixed-P H3 literature agreement is recorded separately from unresolved convergence and other unrun cases.

cases.title: H + CH4 -> H2 + CH3
required_scientific_reviews: Exact PES/version and isotope masses match the reference; archive model bytes and licenses.
Electronic, nuclear-spin and equivalent-channel conventions match; never reapply factors already in the table.
Inspect PMF overlap, correlated uncertainty including PMF and recrossing, and the full transmission plateau.
Check replica independence, source integrity, and all rate outputs with benchmarks/published_rates/compare.py.
blockers: Converged methane thermal-rate sampling has not been run; the fixed 0.1 fs short P128 NVE energy gate fails while smaller-step diagnostics remain separate.
The bounded independent reference pilot has severe importance-weight concentration and unresolved geometric-domain tails. A useful estimator needs a separately reviewed design before production.
available_evidence: Exact RPMDrate CBE PES-2008 source/build pinned; barrier 15.0142843 kcal/mol versus published 15.01; native/Python maps, unit checks and short umbrella/checkpoint probes pass.
All 768 excluded independent-reference pilot draws retained, including 127 geometric zeros; importance ESS is only 4.33, 7.18 and 6.14 across the three full ensembles. No rate estimate is promoted.

blockers: Supplementary parent-time-half kappa equivalence still fails: 95% interval [-0.0231007344,+0.0362553622] is not wholly within +/-0.03.

P128-to-P256 equilibrium refinement passes. All eight fixed P256 parent chains are complete and their raw archive is independently verified; the full dynamic bead comparison is not yet complete. The P64 equilibrium control remains a recorded failure.

Independent MC umbrella sampling fails precision at the complete 30000-sweep stage and is continuing the fixed 100000-sweep prefix. Independent surface-reference agreement does not validate the production MD umbrella workflow.
available_evidence: Complete independent classical reference rate 1.5454063761e-18 agrees with paper 1.55e-18 within its stated approximately 5% precision.

Complete P128 four-pair quantum rate 1.9678563652801757e-16 has nominal 95% CI [1.9329386067562914e-16,2.003404899068246e-16], +0.915711% from paper 1.95e-16. All eleven fixed-P primary criteria pass; kappa relative half-width 2.317249% is below the unchanged 3% threshold.

All eight chains and 800 raw child chunks were independently reconstructed and exactly replayed after actual base-plus-increment archive extraction. Same-chain partition/transmission covariance is retained.

cases.title: H surface diffusion on Ni(100)
required_scientific_reviews: Match the exact metal/hydrogen model, isotope, lattice constant, coverage or loading and movable/frozen layers.
Separate two-dimensional surface diffusion from three-dimensional bulk diffusion and finite-cluster escape.
Inspect unwrapped centroid MSD and VACF, drift subtraction, fit windows and independent-replica error bars.
Transcribe a source-matched table or digitized curve with uncertainty and provenance before comparison.
available_evidence: Pinned author-attributed Cambridge nimetpot.f90 identifies EAM4 Ni(100)/H and explicitly cites the 2012 paper; the unchanged nb=1 suffix builds through an isolated static adapter.
Four static geometries, four cutoff probes and ten collected tests pass, covering active-coordinate derivatives, invariances and fixed/mobile partitions; no diffusion or mixed-bead dynamics was run.
blockers: Original numerical targets and complete 2012 masses, lattice, movable/fixed partitions, temperature grid, bead conventions and sampling protocol remain unresolved; current OPTIM examples do not establish those paper settings.
The author-cited source has static implementation checks only; original 2012 executable identity, RPMD dynamics and diffusion convergence remain unverified.
The separate NiAlH_jea software pilot remains an unmatched model and is not substituted for EAM4.

cases.title: q-TIP4P/F H2O self-diffusion at 298 K
required_scientific_reviews: Match 216 molecules, density 0.997 g/cm3, temperature, isotope masses, unthermostatted physical production and the source finite-size convention.
Match or converge the 9-A short-range cutoff, long-range electrostatics and tail corrections; never impose rigid bonds on q-TIP4P/F.
Establish liquid equilibrium (structure and stationarity), unwrapped molecular-centroid VACF/MSD consistency, plateau and independent replica uncertainty.
Compare the finite 216-molecule diffusion value separately from an infinite-size extrapolation; finite-size dependence is expected.
blockers: Complete the original eight-chain equilibrium and transport assessment before adopting any separately registered all-chain preparation extension. Existing failed preparation gates are retained.
Long quantum production, matched isotope/mass conventions, finite-size comparison and PyRPMD-own long-time transport validation remain incomplete. Tiny pilots do not establish those results.
available_evidence: An eight-seed 216-molecule classical OpenMM full-PME reference campaign is running; original preparation and production prefixes are retained. Force, checkpoint, cadence and extension/coordinator contracts are separately tested.

cases.title: q-TIP4P/F liquid infrared spectrum (cross-method comparison)
required_scientific_reviews: Original Figure 5 is PA-CMD; TRPMD/RPMD spectra are method comparisons, not implementation agreement with PA-CMD.
Evaluate whole-molecule dipoles on each bead and average dipoles; preserve a flexible O-H potential.
Compare full bending/stretching/librational bands, not just a fitted peak, using archived source curves and explicit broadening/normalization.
Converge thermostat friction for TRPMD, cadence/Nyquist frequency, record length, window function and liquid equilibrium; relative IR is not absolute absorbance.
blockers: No source digitization or source-sized liquid production spectrum has been generated.
The tiny pilot outputs an RPMD spectrum diagnostic only; it is neither PA-CMD nor a physically converged liquid IR result.
